cairnryan_harbour_harbourmaster.text: Harbour Office. I keep the tide tables, the weather and a large biscuit tin.
Loch Ryan is a sheltered sea loch about eight miles long, so the ferries can run in nearly all weathers.
South of here is the Mull of Galloway, the most southerly point in Scotland. Its lighthouse was lit in 1830.
Ternlets are about at dawn and in the day. Plungebeaks are about all hours. Take binoculars, not sandwiches.
